title: Japan Liquidity Enhancement Auction, remaining maturities 1-5 years (¥700bn announced) — the family's only controlled repeat: same size, same menu, one variable moved
source: EST: two MOF primaries, both re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 for this initial research. (1) The English September 2026 auction calendar, policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2609e.htm (HTTP 200, 25,796 bytes): 'Sep. 10, 2026 | Liquidity Enhancement Auction (remaining maturities of 1-5 years)', with an announcement link present and the 'Issues Re-opened' cell still empty. (2) MOF's own announcement, calendar/announcement/auct20260903e.htm (HTTP 200, 18,561 bytes), dated September 3, 2026: Auction Date September 10, 2026, Issue Date September 11, 2026, Offering Amount 'About 700 billion yen', eligible issues 'No.476-488 of outstanding 2-year JGBs, No.154-185 of outstanding 5-year, No.348-363 of outstanding 10-year, No.97-129 of outstanding 20-year, No.1-5 of outstanding 30-year'. NOTE THE PATH: the announcement lives under auction/CALENDAR/announcement/, not auction/announcement/ — the shortened form both sibling proposals cite 404s. Filed `estimate` on the two counts this lane records for every JGB entry, neither of them date doubt: the reopened-issue list does not exist until MOF's 'Issues Re-opened' page publishes on the day, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Discovered 2026-09-09 by two sibling adjacency sweeps independently (proposals/*.from-jgb-liquidity-enhancement-1-5y-2026-11-20.json and *.from-jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-09-25.json, both read as input for this canonical file and now shadowed by it); researched 2026-09-09
notes: Researched 2026-09-09 at D-1 (docs/research/events/jgb-liquidity-enhancement-1-5y-2026-09-10.md). THIS PRINT IS THE FAMILY'S ONLY CONTROLLED REPEAT AND THAT IS WHY IT EARNS A SESSION. Its announced menu is the 2026-07-16 menu with ONLY the 2-Year window advanced: 5-Year No.154-185, 10-Year No.348-363, 20-Year No.97-129 and 30-Year No.1-5 are byte-identical across the two announcements, and their computed outstanding is identical too (¥114.59tn / ¥120.73tn / ¥49.95tn / ¥1.50tn), at the same ¥700bn offering. Total eligible moves ¥323.77tn → ¥323.95tn, +0.06%. So any sector overweight that moves against July is behaviour, not a menu change — the control the family's 'the pocket died on 2026-07-16' claim has never had. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE FAMILY'S OWN NUMBERS, both computed this session from MOF primaries. (1) THE PUBLISHED ¥321.15tn BASIS OMITS AN ELIGIBLE ISSUE. 2-Year No.488 is on MOF's announced list but absent from the Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls workbook (last saved 2026-08-13; No.488 was auctioned 2026-08-28). Its own result page eresul20260828.htm gives coupon 1.7%, competitive ¥2,145.4bn + non-competitive ¥0.165bn + Non-Price Competitive I ¥654.0bn = ¥2.80tn. Corrected basis ¥323.95tn: 2Y 11.48% (not 10.71%) · 5Y 35.37% · 10Y 37.27% · 20Y 15.42% · 30Y 0.46%. Any 2-Year overweight quoted on the announced basis is overstated ~7% relative; the 10Y:5Y share ratio the family's headline test rests on moves 1.0535 → 1.0537 and is unaffected. (2) THE '≥1% COUPON POCKET' HAS INVERTED ITS OWN COMPOSITION AND IS NO LONGER COMPARABLE ACROSS THE WINDOW IT IS QUOTED OVER. The ≥1% bucket was 18.67% of the menu on 2025-09-08 and 77.8% of it was 20-Year paper; it is 39.73% on 2026-09-10 and only 38.8% of it is 20-Year, with 26.9% 2-Year and 33.1% 5-Year — the newest paper on the menu, the opposite of the seasoned pre-2012 stock the mechanism describes. And the decay the 1-5y sibling attributed to auction SIZE continued at a CONSTANT size: across the five ¥700bn prints the pocket ran +1.205 / +0.649 / +0.562 / +0.094 / −0.878 while the offering never moved, corr(pocket, ≥1% share) = −0.978. Size is refuted as the mechanism; composition and time cannot be separated (they correlate +0.996 at n=5). Quote the vintage split (age ≥12y), which is defined on age directly and does not drift. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Three sibling forward tests score off tomorrow's same page — FT-jgb-liquidity-enhancement-1-5y-2026-11-20-1 and -3, and FT-jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-09-25-4 — and the first two are NOT the same test as the third, which is a level threshold where they are a pairwise ordering; a page can confirm one and kill the other. Each stays with its own lane to score. The auction shares its date with treasury-30y-bond-2026-09-10, ppi-2026-09-10, ecb-decision-2026-09-10, treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-09-10 and three Treasury buyback operations, and sits five days before jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
